blocks.text: 0.0.2a stores Calculator machine and powered-item energy with 64-bit counters. NeoForge FE remains an int-valued compatibility capability, so a single FE call is bounded even when the underlying buffer is much larger. Native long-valued adapters can see the full buffer.

rows: Multiplies every machine buffer after its normal machine capacity.
Per-machine multiplier applied after the configured base capacity.
Multiplies transfer/charging limits without changing conversion ratios.

blocks.text: Existing R9 machine saves migrate automatically because the Energy NBT field is read as a long. Powered items retain the legacy int energy component for downgrade visibility and add a long component for values above 2,147,483,647 FE.
Large buffers do not make one transfer unlimited. FE, GT packet limits, machine transfer rates, item charge rates, side modes and adapter policy still cap each operation.

Client setting information.energyUnit can display FE or an explicitly configured GT EU, Mekanism J or MI EU view. If an external ratio is inherited rather than explicitly configured, the GUI falls back to FE instead of guessing.
